pairs.summary: SMAD3 and ZKSCAN3 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 4 of 14 profiles analysed (A549 lung adenocarcinoma; K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; MDA-MB-468 triple-negative breast cancer; SW620 colorectal adenocarcinoma (metastasis)). Median lift 1.65x, typical spacing ~84 bp between sites. In 3 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. Caution: overlapping sites — the signal may reflect one family/shared motif rather than two distinct factors. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
